passages.text: Now, O daughter of troops, mobilize your troops; for a siege is laid against us! With a rod they will strike the cheek of the judge of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel face danger now.
Enemies surround them.
A siege is set against Israel.
Daughter of troops, gather your soldiers.
Prepare for battle.
The enemy will strike Israel’s judge on the cheek with a rod.
passages.original: עַתָּה֙ תִּתְגֹּדְדִ֣י בַת־ גְּד֔וּד מָצ֖וֹר שָׂ֣ם עָלֵ֑ינוּ בַּשֵּׁ֙בֶט֙ יַכּ֣וּ עַֽל־ הַלְּחִ֔י אֵ֖ת שֹׁפֵ֥ט יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, who are small among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me One to be ruler over Israel — One whose origins are of old, from the days of eternity.
passages.sermon:
Bethlehem Ephrathah is a small town in Judah.
Bethlehem is not important among the clans of Judah.
God speaks to Bethlehem.
God says, “From you, Bethlehem, someone will come out for Me.”
This person will become ruler over Israel.
This ruler’s origins are from ancient times.
His beginnings are from days of eternity.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה בֵּֽית־ לֶ֣חֶם אֶפְרָ֗תָה צָעִיר֙ לִֽהְיוֹת֙ בְּאַלְפֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה מִמְּךָ֙ לִ֣י יֵצֵ֔א לִֽהְי֥וֹת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וּמוֹצָאֹתָ֥יו מִקֶּ֖דֶם מִימֵ֥י עוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore Israel will be abandoned until she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to the children of Israel.
passages.sermon:
God will abandon Israel for a time.
He will do this until the woman in labor gives birth.
After she gives birth, the rest of His brothers will return.
They will return to the children of Israel.
passages.original: לָכֵ֣ן יִתְּנֵ֔ם עַד־ עֵ֥ת יוֹלֵדָ֖ה יָלָ֑דָה וְיֶ֣תֶר אֶחָ֔יו יְשׁוּב֖וּן עַל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majestic name of the LORD His God. And they will dwell securely, for then His greatness will extend to the ends of the earth.
passages.sermon:
A ruler will come from Bethlehem Ephrathah.
He will shepherd His people Israel.
He will stand firm.
He will lead with the strength of the LORD.
He will act in the majestic name of the LORD His God.
His people will live in safety.
His greatness will reach to the ends of the earth.
passages.original: וְעָמַ֗ד וְרָעָה֙ בְּעֹ֣ז יְהוָ֔ה בִּגְא֕וֹן שֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑יו וְיָשָׁ֕בוּ כִּֽי־ עַתָּ֥ה יִגְדַּ֖ל עַד־ אַפְסֵי־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: And He will be our peace when Assyria invades our land and tramples our citadels. We will raise against it seven shepherds, even eight leaders of men.
passages.sermon:
God will give us peace.
Assyria may invade our land.
Assyria may trample our strong cities.
God will not leave us helpless.
We will stand against Assyria.
We will appoint seven shepherds.
We will also appoint eight leaders among men.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֥ה זֶ֖ה שָׁל֑וֹם אַשּׁ֣וּר׀ כִּֽי־ יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֗נוּ וְכִ֤י יִדְרֹךְ֙ בְּאַרְמְנֹתֵ֔ינוּ וַהֲקֵמֹ֤נוּ עָלָיו֙ שִׁבְעָ֣ה רֹעִ֔ים וּשְׁמֹנָ֖ה נְסִיכֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: And they will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the blade drawn. So He will deliver us when Assyria invades our land and marches into our borders.
passages.sermon:
The people will rule the land of Assyria with the sword.
They will rule the land of Nimrod with a drawn blade.
The Lord will deliver us from Assyria.
He will save us when Assyria enters our land.
He will protect us when Assyria crosses into our borders.
passages.original: וְרָע֞וּ אֶת־ אֶ֤רֶץ אַשּׁוּר֙ בַּחֶ֔רֶב וְאֶת־ אֶ֥רֶץ נִמְרֹ֖ד בִּפְתָחֶ֑יהָ וְהִצִּיל֙ מֵֽאַשּׁ֔וּר כִּֽי־ יָב֣וֹא בְאַרְצֵ֔נוּ וְכִ֥י יִדְרֹ֖ךְ בִּגְבוּלֵֽנוּ׃ס

passages.text: Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or linger for mankind.
passages.sermon:
The remnant of Jacob will remain.
They will live among many peoples.
They will be like dew from the LORD.
They will be like showers on the grass.
This dew and these showers do not wait for any man.
They do not depend on mankind.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ שְׁאֵרִ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֗ב בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּטַל֙ מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה כִּרְבִיבִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ עֵ֑שֶׂב אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ יְקַוֶּה֙ לְאִ֔ישׁ וְלֹ֥א יְיַחֵ֖ל לִבְנֵ֥י אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Then the remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which tramples and tears as it passes through, with no one to rescue them.
passages.sermon:
The remnant of Jacob will live among the nations.
They will be in the midst of many peoples.
They will be like a lion among the beasts of the forest.
They will be like a young lion among flocks of sheep.
The remnant will pass through the peoples.
They will trample and tear as they go.
No one will rescue those they attack.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֩ שְׁאֵרִ֨ית יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּגּוֹיִ֗ם בְּקֶ֙רֶב֙ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֔ים כְּאַרְיֵה֙ בְּבַהֲמ֣וֹת יַ֔עַר כִּכְפִ֖יר בְּעֶדְרֵי צֹ֑אן אֲשֶׁ֧ר אִם עָבַ֛ר וְרָמַ֥ס וְטָרַ֖ף וְאֵ֥ין מַצִּֽיל׃

passages.text: Your hand will be lifted over your foes, and all your enemies will be cut off.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the remnant of Jacob.
God promises victory over their foes.
God will lift their hand above their enemies.
God will cut off all their enemies.
passages.original: תָּרֹ֥ם יָדְךָ֖ עַל־ צָרֶ֑יךָ וְכָל־ אֹיְבֶ֖יךָ יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃פ

passages.text: “In that day,” declares the LORD, “I will remove your horses from among you and wreck your chariots.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD promises a future day.
On that day, the LORD will act.
The LORD will remove your horses from among you.
The LORD will destroy your chariots.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה בַיּוֹם־ הַהוּא֙ נְאֻם־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י סוּסֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהַאֲבַדְתִּ֖י מַרְכְּבֹתֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I will remove the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD promises action.
The LORD will remove the cities from your land.
The LORD will tear down all your strongholds.
passages.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֖י עָרֵ֣י אַרְצֶ֑ךָ וְהָרַסְתִּ֖י כָּל־ מִבְצָרֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I will cut the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no fortune-tellers.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks with authority.
The LORD promises to act on a coming day.
The LORD will remove sorcery from your hand.
You will not have any fortune-tellers among you.
passages.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י כְשָׁפִ֖ים מִיָּדֶ֑ךָ וּֽמְעוֹנְנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יִֽהְיוּ־ לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: I will also cut off the carved images and sacred pillars from among you, so that you will no longer bow down to the work of your own hands.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD will remove your carved images from among you.
The LORD will take away your sacred pillars from your midst.
You will not bow down anymore to things you have made with your own hands.
passages.original: וְהִכְרַתִּ֧י פְסִילֶ֛יךָ וּמַצֵּבוֹתֶ֖יךָ מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְלֹֽא־ תִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֥ה ע֖וֹד לְמַעֲשֵׂ֥ה יָדֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: I will root out the Asherah poles from your midst and demolish your cities.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God promises to act with power.
God will remove the Asherah poles from among you.
God will destroy your cities.

passages.text: I will take vengeance in anger and wrath upon the nations that have not obeyed Me.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks.
The LORD will act with anger and wrath.
The LORD will take vengeance.
The LORD will punish the nations.
These nations have not obeyed the LORD.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֜יתִי בְּאַ֧ף וּבְחֵמָ֛ה נָקָ֖ם אֶת־ הַגּוֹיִ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֥א שָׁמֵֽעוּ׃ס
